name: Upzoned Transit
author: NoahGarrf
description:
Subway Builder mod that lets players upzone around their stations, generating new population groups both in existing and new demand points. Designed to be fairly realistic:

- Players can upzone and develop around stations, but there is no guarantee that people who move near stations will actually use the transit system.

When generating commuting pairs, the mod considers:

- Network size
- Network utility

These factors determine the likelihood that both ends of a generated commuting pair will be located near transit.

Network size also affects the demand to live and develop near transit.
The larger your transit network becomes, the more population you generate when upzoning around stations.

Because of these factors, the mod scales with the size and usefulness of your network. Pretty cool right? Well I thought it was atleast.
